entities.name: Ethyl ester substrate
observations: SELFIES decodes to CCOC(=O)C1=CC2=C(C(=O)NC3=C(Cl)C=NC=C3Cl)C=CC(OC)=C2O1 and contains an ethyl ester group, CCOC(=O)–.

entities.name: Ethyl ester saponification
observations: Base-promoted hydrolysis changes –C(=O)OCH2CH3 to –C(=O)OH after workup; under basic conditions the immediate product is the carboxylate salt.
